YouTube 21.38.3 | YouTubePlus_21.38.3_6.0b1

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!

**Cracked by** [@itzzace](https://github.com/itzzace)

> [!NOTE]
> - :key: no subscription required. 
> - ✅ New Downloads manager.
> - 📺 Full 4KHDR support. YTUHD no longer needed 
> - 📝 [6.0b1 release notes](https://github.com/dayanch96/YTLite/releases/tag/v6.0-b1) 
> - ⚠️ beta release, some features may still glitch
>
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks: 
> - `YouPip` `YTUHD` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic` `Gonerino`

> [!WARNING]
> -  21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
